content.comment_body: Hello all, Before making a purchase, I have a question about a network setup I want to implement. I wish to connect a [product_name] device with an Ethernet port (using [product_name] V8.3 software), an HMI 7'' panel, and a router through a switch. The [product_name] will be installed inside a panel, the HMI on the panel door, and the router outside the building. All devices will use TCP/IP protocol with RJ45 cables. The [product_name] handles the logic, the HMI displays data from sources like a weather station and water tanks, and the router will be equipped with an IoT card to enable remote monitoring of the system. Do you think this is feasible, or are there any specific concerns I should keep in mind?
Hello! I suggest using a VPN to secure remote access to your [product_name] device. This involves configuring a secure VPN connection between your PC and the [product_name] V8 system.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is asking about the possibility and security aspects of connecting a [product_name] device, HMI, and router via TCP/IP for remote system monitoring, using [product_name] V8.3 software. The focus is on whether this networked solution can enable safe remote access without compromising automation system security.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to successfully set up a secure and functional network, allowing remote control and monitoring through standard protocols, with protections in place for external access.
